source: PRD 9.50.9 fx-smoke-12: the 12 core processes run after cutover and after failover (FR-50.6 step 6, AC-50.4)
notes: Each process is an ordered list of API steps and a final assertion. Paths go through the gateway (/api/v1/<prefix> is rewritten to the service's /v1/<prefix>, deploy/gateway) and are checked against services/*/api/openapi.yaml by load/tools/test_smoke12.py. {id} is the id returned by an earlier step of the same process. A step marked 'unverified' has no route on main; its reason names the gap, and a runner must count it as failed until the owning wave publishes the route. A process passes only when every step succeeds and the final assertion holds. Request bodies come from the fx-load-10k pool (not built yet).

processes.name: Purchase to pay

steps.unverified: payables serves only settlements:preview and payment-files:preview; no payment run route on main

processes.assert: vendor invoice is paid, GR/IR is cleared for the receipt and the AP subledger equals the journal control account

processes.name: Order to cash
processes.assert: customer invoice is settled and the AR subledger equals the journal control account

processes.name: Production order to RAF
processes.assert: order is ended, the WIP balance is zero and finished goods were received at planned cost (BR-21.1)

processes.name: Journal post
processes.assert: entry is posted, balanced in every currency, and the tenant's hash chain head is this entry (BR-50.3)

processes.name: Bank reconciliation

steps.unverified: treasury has no statement matching route on main (import and read only)

processes.assert: every statement line is matched or listed as an exception

processes.name: Asset depreciation
processes.assert: depreciation journal balances and net book value reconciles to the asset register

processes.name: Project invoice
processes.assert: project invoice total equals the billable transactions of the period

processes.name: Payroll run

steps.unverified: payroll serves gross-to-net per worker only; no payroll run or posting route on main

processes.assert: payroll journal balances and net pay equals the sum of the pay statements

processes.name: Statutory report
processes.assert: the statutory definition's run for the period ties to the trial balance

processes.name: Dashboard

steps.unverified: analytics has no dashboard route on main (same gap as UNVERIFIED_PATHS in load/k6/scenarios.js)

processes.assert: dashboard responds within the dashboard SLO (p95 < 2 s) and its revenue equals the GL

processes.name: Copilot query

steps.unverified: services/agents-ts/api/openapi.yaml declares no paths; the copilot has no HTTP route on main

processes.assert: answer cites data and no write is performed (suggest mode)

processes.name: Mobile pick
processes.assert: pick is confirmed and on-hand at the pick location decreases by the picked quantity
